title: Explicit thresholds in a generalized Turán problem for \(K_{3,t}\)-free graphs
summary: For graphs $F$ and $H$, let $\ex(n,F,H)$ denote the maximum number of copies of $F$ in an $n$-vertex $H$-free graph. Janzer, Longbrake and Yepremyan recently proved that, for fixed $3<a\le b$ and sufficiently large $t$, \[ \ex(n,K_{a,b},K_{3,t})=Θ(n^3). \] We make their threshold explicit, showing that this conclusion holds for all $t\ge τ(b):=2\max\{3,\lceil b/2\rceil\}+1.$ In particular, for every even $b\ge 6$, this matches the necessary threshold $t=b+1$.
